metadata.title: About WAF | Project Execution & Fit-Out Company
metadata.description: Learn about WAF for Business Services — a company executing and fitting out commercial projects, exhibitions, and events from manufacturing to installation.

hero.title: We turn ideas into practical reality
hero.description: A project execution and fit-out company delivering manufacturing, execution, and installation for commercial projects and events, through a specialized team focused on execution quality, commitment, and turning ideas into practical reality.
hero.imageAlt: The WAF team on a project site
